353 / 354: Cortech Summit Mid-Range Table
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-353-354-summit-mid-range-table
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/endurance/summit-mid-range-table/
Spec sheet: 353 / 354
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Summit Mid-Range Table – 353 / 354
Current H1: Cortech Summit - Mid-Range Table - Molded Base with Laminate Top - Models 353 & 354
Subtitle: Mid-Height Table with a Molded Base and a Laminate Delta Top, with an Optional Ballast Door
Current subtitle: Cortech 353 Mid-Range Table with Mid-Size Delta Top, Cortech 354 Mid-Range Table with Large Delta Top
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Summit Mid-Range Table is a mid-height table with a molded base and a laminate delta top, for lounges, dayrooms, and patient-focused spaces in behavioral healthcare and other secure settings. It coordinates with Summit seating for a calm, residential look.
The one-piece molded base has no exposed seams or hardware and attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws. The table is designed to be weighted, and the 353S and 354S have a ballast door for adding sandbags on site.
Base: One-piece rotationally molded high impact polyethylene; no steel or wood components
Top: High-pressure laminate top with a Dura-Edge; it resists moisture and impact and cleans easily
Sizes: Mid delta top (353) or large delta top (354)
Dimensions: 39”W×38”D×25”H
Weight: 51 lbs (top 36 lbs, base 15 lbs)
Weighting: The base can be filled with sandbags; the 353S and 354S have an access door. Do not use loose sand. Optional bolt-down plates available
Flammability Standards: Laminate surfaces pass CAL 117; the base is flame retardant and passes California Technical Bulletin 133
Environmental Certification: GREENGUARD Gold (laminate tops not included)
Easy Cleaning: Sound dampening, and easy to clean, sanitize, and maintain
Base Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Warranty: Lifetime warranty on the base; 5-year warranty on the laminate top, against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
353 – Mid Delta Top: Without access door
353S – Mid Delta Top with Access Door: Ballast door for adding sandbags
354 – Large Delta Top: Without access door
354S – Large Delta Top with Access Door: Ballast door for adding sandbags
Installation and Options
Assembly: The base attaches to the top with tamper-resistant screws; hardware bit size is T40
Weighting: Add sandbags through the access door on the 353S or 354S; do not use loose sand
[H2] Applications
The Summit Mid-Range Table suits lounges and dayrooms that want a stable, easy-to-clean table at a comfortable height.
Typical applications include:
Dayrooms, lounges, and waiting areas in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Dining and activity areas in residential treatment centers
Other secure settings that want a calm, residential look
Explore Anchortex's Behavioral Healthcare Anti-Ligature Furniture and Prison and Detention Furniture collections for more institutional furniture.
[H2] About Cortech Summit Series
The Cortech Summit Series is a line of molded seating and tables with a calm, residential look, made for behavioral healthcare facilities and other secure settings. Most Summit seating comes in a standard molded finish or with a Veldura soft-touch exterior.
The Summit Series includes:
Chairs: Guest Chair (300 / 301), Accent Chair (310 / 311), and Lounge Chair (320 / 321)
Stools: Summit Stool (330 / 331)
Tables: Side Table (342 / 343), Mid-Range Table (353 / 354), and All Purpose Table (361 / 363 / 364)
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (55 characters): Cortech Summit Mid-Range Table - 353 / 354 at Anchortex
Meta description (159 characters): Shop the Cortech Summit Mid-Range Table. A mid-height table with a one-piece molded base and a laminate delta top, with an optional ballast door for weighting.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Summit Series" is a new section for the Summit chairs, stools, and tables. It is the same on each Summit page.
H1: I took out "Molded Base with Laminate Top" and "Models."
Variants: your page has only the 353S and 354S (with ballast door). The Cortech spec sheet also lists the 353 and 354 without an access door. I listed all four in Available Models. Would you like the two models without a door added as variants?
Weight: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says 51 lbs (top 36 lbs, base 15 lbs), so I used 51 lbs.
Dimensions: the Cortech spec sheet gives one size (39”W×38”D×25”H) and one weight for both tops.
Bolt-down plates: the Cortech spec sheet says optional bolt-down plates are available, but there is no model number for them. The FAQ on the Cortech product page says the table cannot be bolted down (it names the Summit Side Table, so it looks copied). I used the spec sheet.
GREENGUARD Gold: the Cortech spec sheet says "Greenguard Gold Certified *Laminate Tops not included," which I read as the certification covering the base only. I wrote "(laminate tops not included)." Please check the wording.
Product images: the page has three images, including a Summit color chart. The Cortech product page has photos of the Mid-Range Table in all 18 base colors. Would you like me to add them?
